text: Let us recap. Every electrode has a potential, measured as a reduction potential against the standard hydrogen electrode, or in practice against calomel. The electrochemical series ranks reducing and oxidising power. In a voltaic cell, oxidation happens at the negative anode, reduction at the positive cathode, and a salt bridge closes the circuit. E nought cell is cathode minus anode, corrected by the Nernst equation. Delta G is minus n F E, which links cell potential to the equilibrium constant, and one faraday deposits one gram equivalent. And batteries and fuel cells put all of it to work.
